description: Plays `steps` on the open page frame by frame and returns what changed in the state (the whole state when nothing did), the console lines and errors the steps raised, a Motion line when the subject turned or stopped under a held key or would stutter on a 100 Hz screen, and a Sound line on a page that makes sound. Each mouse and touch step names the object under it and its distance. `expect` adds one ✓ or ✗ line per path; `save` keeps the play as a check `test` reruns, only when every entry holds. A malformed step fails the call before anything plays; a failing `expect` entry is reported, not raised. Use `feel` to measure how an event reacts on screen, `observe` to read the state without playing, and `eval` to set it with code. Options in full: the skill's references/tools.md.

expect.description: Checked against the state after the steps, keyed by dotted paths into observe() ("coins.0.x"): a number, string or boolean (equal), [min, max] (a range; two numbers always are), a list of other values (one of them) or null (exists).

frames.description: Frames to wait at each hovered object (default 1).

game.description: The name the game was opened under with the `open` tool, to act on ("main" by default; a subagent uses its own).

hover.description: After the steps, the mouse moves to each named object's centre; one diff per name after `frames`.

look.description: Also return `look`'s picture after the steps.

record.description: true: plays the steps in real time (1/60 s a frame, 15 s at most) into a GIF in the run folder; the reply has four moments and the real frame intervals.

save.description: Save the steps and `expect` as a check of this name in game-tests.json when every Expect entry holds; the call plays from a fresh reload, its leading state steps as setup.

steps.description: Steps, in order: { key, frames? } (held, then released); { key, down: true|false } (held across steps); { mouse: click|dblclick|down|up|move, x, y }; { mouse: move, relative: [dx, dy] } (pointer lock); { wheel: deltaY, x?, y? }; { resize: [w, h] }; { scroll: px | { progress: 0..1 } | { to: "#id" } }; { touch: start|move|end|tap, x, y }; { wait: frames, draw? }; { action, ...args } (window.__game.act); { state: {...} } (window.__game.setState, then one frame); { until: {...}, max? } (until the state holds, values as `expect`'s; `max` 600 frames by default); { clock: { timescale?, paused? } } (paused: false plays in real time; the clock reads 60 s at frame 0 on purpose). Each step advances `frames` (default 1) and draws only its last (draw: true draws each); `frames: 0` sends it on the same frame as the next.

trace.description: Up to 6 dotted paths into observe(), read each frame (the first 600): first and last value, peak or low, and first change, with frames.

name: interact
